items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: a friend of mine, in fact Alan Eichler who books some of the performers into Marty's

ctx.x: I have no idea whether it was issued or not. But I told them to keep the money. I was, you know, I'm not the kind to say, I won't do this. Sometimes I do some things and I'm sorry I did them. But I don't know whether they issued it or not but a friend of mine, in fact Alan Eichler who books some of the performers into Marty's, he's got a lot of stuff down there and he told me he had that, I don't know, a tape of that particular version and he sent it to me. And then at the same session I did a tune, I don't even…
Needless to say this does not appear on your, in your jazz discography.
